stories.title: Vigilance rouge "pluie-inondation" dans le Gard et l'Hérault : 200mm de pluie sont déjà tombés en 24 heures, annonce la préfecture

en.title: Red alert for "rain-flooding" in Gard and Hérault: 200mm of rain already fallen in 24 hours, prefecture announces
en.summary: Two French departments have been placed on red alert due to an exceptional Mediterranean weather event that has already produced significant rainfall.

en.title: Weather: what is a Mediterranean episode?
en.summary: Mediterranean and Cévenol episodes are violent weather phenomena that typically occur in autumn and can cause severe flooding in affected regions.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis annoncent la fin officielle de la mission de la coalition antijihadiste déployée depuis 2014 en Irak

en.title: United States announces official end of anti-jihadist coalition mission deployed since 2014 in Iraq
en.summary: The United States has officially concluded its military coalition mission in Iraq, with Iraq's Prime Minister marking the transition to Iraqi sovereignty.

stories.title: Javier Milei, zélote de la tronçonneuse, arrive en petite forme économique à Paris

en.title: Javier Milei, zealot of the chainsaw, arrives in poor economic form in Paris
en.summary: Argentina's president faces rising unemployment and inflation as his libertarian economic policies have shifted toward recession rather than delivering promised gains.

stories.title: "Le RN a changé en surface, il a refait la façade", commente François Ruffin, après des écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella par Mediapart

en.title: "The RN changed on the surface, it redid the facade", comments François Ruffin, after antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella by Mediapart
en.summary: François Ruffin criticized the National Rally party following allegations of antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella, noting the party's historical founding and its political culture.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella accusé d’antisémitisme : «la suite de nos révélations arrive», promet Fabrice Arfi de Mediapart

en.title: Jordan Bardella accused of antisemitism: "the rest of our revelations is coming", promises Fabrice Arfi of Mediapart
en.summary: A Mediapart journalist announced further evidence regarding antisemitism accusations against the MEP, while Bardella denied the allegations and announced plans to pursue defamation legal action.

stories.title: Ecrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : "Ou Mediapart manipule l'opinion publique, ou Mediapart se fait enfumer", réagit le député RN Sébastien Chenu

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "Either Mediapart is manipulating public opinion, or Mediapart is being fooled", reacts RN deputy Sébastien Chenu
en.summary: An RN deputy questioned Mediapart's credibility regarding antisemitic writing allegations, while the investigation outlet had previously criticized the National Rally's response to threats.

stories.title: "La suite de nos révélations arrive", promet Fabrice Arfi de Mediapart, après les accusations d'antisémitisme contre Jordan Bardella

en.title: "The rest of our revelations is coming", promises Fabrice Arfi of Mediapart, after accusations of antisemitism against Jordan Bardella
en.summary: Mediapart's investigations head indicated additional evidence would be released regarding antisemitism accusations, while Bardella denied wrongdoing and announced multiple defamation lawsuits against the outlet.

stories.title: Orages : premier phénomène cévenol de l’automne, le Gard et l’Hérault en vigilance rouge ce mercredi

en.title: Storms: first autumn Cevenol phenomenon, Gard and Hérault on red alert Wednesday
en.summary: Gard and Hérault departments are placed on red alert for rainfall, flooding and storms starting Wednesday morning. Rail traffic will be significantly disrupted and schools have been closed.

stories.title: Ecoles fermées, transports suspendus... le Gard et l’Hérault en alerte rouge face à un épisode méditerranéen «exceptionnel»

en.title: Schools closed, transport suspended... Gard and Hérault on red alert facing an "exceptional" Mediterranean episode
en.summary: Gard and Hérault are under red alert for an exceptional Mediterranean weather event. Lozère and Ardèche remain on orange alert, with Bouches-du-Rhône joining them from noon.

stories.title: L'Hérault et le Gard placés en vigilance rouge pour un risque de pluies et d'inondations en raison d'un "épisode méditerranéen exceptionnel", annonce Météo-France

en.title: Hérault and Gard placed on red alert for risk of rainfall and flooding due to an "exceptional Mediterranean episode", announces Météo-France
en.summary: Hérault and Gard are on red alert for exceptional rainfall and flooding risks from a Mediterranean weather system. Remarkable rainfall totals are expected first in the Cevennes region then in urban plains.

stories.title: Le Gard et l’Hérault placés en vigilance rouge « pluie-inondation », Météo-France prévoit un épisode méditerranéen « remarquable », voire « exceptionnel »

en.title: Gard and Hérault placed on red alert for "rainfall-flooding", Météo-France predicts a "remarkable", even "exceptional" Mediterranean episode
en.summary: Gard and Hérault are on red alert for an exceptional Mediterranean weather event bringing significant rainfall and flooding risk. Lozère and Ardèche are on orange alert, with Bouches-du-Rhône joining at noon, and schools in Gard have closed.

stories.title: Pour gagner sa place sur le marché, l’écosystème spatial allemand poursuit sa structuration

en.title: To gain its place on the market, Germany's space ecosystem continues its structuring
en.summary: Germany's space sector is expanding through factory openings and company acquisitions, aligned with the government's strategy to build an industrial and technological base competitive at European levels.

stories.title: OpenAI reporte son IPO et négocie 30 milliards de dollars en privé

en.title: OpenAI postpones its IPO and negotiates 30 billion dollars in private funding
en.summary: OpenAI is raising at least 30 billion dollars in private capital at a pre-money valuation of around 1,400 billion dollars, with its IPO postponed to 2027 at the earliest, leaving Anthropic as the leading AI company candidate for public listing.

stories.title: Inflation à 3 % : le budget 2027 arrive au moment où la demande se contracte

en.title: Inflation at 3%: the 2027 budget arrives as demand contracts
en.summary: Inflation accelerated to 3 percent year-on-year in September driven by energy prices, while household spending on goods fell in August, presenting challenges for the government's 2027 budget and deficit trajectory ahead.

stories.title: Malgré les alertes de cybersécurité, OpenAI lance Dots, son agent IA à tout faire

en.title: Despite cybersecurity alerts, OpenAI launches Dots, its all-purpose AI agent
en.summary: OpenAI introduced Dots, an AI agent designed to automate personal and professional tasks for ChatGPT Pro subscribers, though the launch follows multiple cybersecurity incidents raising concerns about autonomous AI assistant capabilities.

stories.title: OPINION. « Néobanques : après la bataille des usages, celle de la confiance »

en.title: OPINION. "Neobanks: after the battle for usage, the battle for trust"
en.summary: Revolut's acquisition of a French banking license this summer may signal a shift in the neobank industry from competing on user adoption to building deeper financial relationships with customers.
